NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 6 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 18 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 18, 12:20 AM ET

The Chiefs are the top-projected defense on the Week 6 DraftKings main slate at 7.5 DraftKings points for $3,600, against the Chargers. Rams (7.4, $3,800) and Patriots (7.2, $3,500) are next.

The Panthers return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.64 projected points per $1,000 at $2,500.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 18, 12:20 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 6

Chiefs, KC vs LAC ($3,600)

Chiefs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 7.5 DraftKings points at $3,600. That is 0.1 points clear of Rams. The salary works out to 2.10 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 8 at the position. Across 25,000 simulations Chiefs averaged 7.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.5, and it holds 4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 7.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 41.5.

Value: Panthers, CAR at PHI ($2,500)

Panthers projects for 6.6 DraftKings points at $2,500, which works out to 2.64 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 8 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 25,000 simulations Panthers averaged 6.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.8, and it holds 11% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Carolina is a 3-point favorite on the road against Philadelphia, with an implied team total of 21.25 in a game totaled at 39.5.
